title: kengyilia mutica
intro: Kengyilia mutica, commonly known as Tibetan milkvetch, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in Tibetan medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Kengyilia mutica include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
